title: Lazy Lemon Bliss Soup
description: A soothing soup that combines the sweetness of bliss with the tanginess of lemon.
instructions: In a large pot, combine bliss, lemon juice, water, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the pot to medium heat and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
